prompt: 你要寫信向供應商詢問零件價格。哪一句開頭最合適？
options: I am writing to ask for a quotation for 500 bearings.
I write for ask a quotation of 500 bearings.
I am writing for asking a quotation to 500 bearings.
answer: I am writing to ask for a quotation for 500 bearings.

wrong.I write for ask a quotation of 500 beari: 表示目的要用 to + 原形動詞；for 後面不接原形動詞。
wrong.I am writing for asking a quotation to 5: ask for 才是要求，for asking 不自然；quotation 後面用 for 接商品。

why: I am writing to ... 是商務郵件常見的開場，ask for a quotation 是詢價。
tip: 商務信開場：I am writing to...。
say: I am writing to ask for a quotation for 500 bearings.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: Could you please send me the delivery schedule?
Could you please to send me the delivery schedule?
Could you please sending me the delivery schedule?
answer: Could you please send me the delivery schedule?

wrong.Could you please to send me the delivery: Could you 後面接原形動詞，不加 to。
wrong.Could you please sending me the delivery: Could you 後面不能接 V-ing。

why: Could you + 原形動詞 是禮貌請求。
tip: Could you 後面接原形動詞。
say: Could you please send me the delivery schedule?

text: We apologize _____ the delay in shipment.
options: for
about to
of

wrong.about to: about to 後面接動詞，表示即將，不能這樣道歉。
wrong.of: apologize 的搭配是 apologize for 事情，不用 of。

why: apologize for + 名詞 表示為……道歉。
say: We apologize for the delay in shipment.

prompt: Please find the attached file. 這句話是什麼意思？
options: 請見附件
請找出這個檔案
請不要打開檔案

wrong.請找出這個檔案: 這是商務書信用語，檔案已經附上，不是要對方去找。
wrong.請不要打開檔案: 句子沒有禁止的意思，而是請對方查看附件。

why: Please find attached 是正式信件中請對方查看附件的客套說法。

prompt: 客戶說收到的零件有瑕疵，你要回信表示會處理。哪一句最合適？
options: We will investigate the defect and get back to you by Friday.
We will investigate the defect and get back with you on Friday ago.
We investigate the defect and will back you Friday.
answer: We will investigate the defect and get back to you by Friday.

wrong.We will investigate the defect and get b: ago 用於過去，不能和未來的 Friday 連用。
wrong.We investigate the defect and will back: 時態與搭配混亂，get back to you 是固定說法，不能說 will back you。

why: get back to you 表示回覆你，by Friday 是最晚的期限。
tip: 回覆對方：get back to you。
say: We will investigate the defect and get back to you by Friday.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The shipment will arrive on Monday.
The shipment will arrives on Monday.
The shipment will arrive at Monday.
answer: The shipment will arrive on Monday.

will 後面要接原形動詞 arrive。
星期幾前面用 on，不用 at。

why: will + 原形動詞；星期前用 on。
say: The shipment will arrive on Monday.

text: Please confirm the order number _____ you receive this email.
options: as soon as
as long as
as well as

wrong.as long as: as long as 表示只要，不表示收到後立刻。
wrong.as well as: as well as 表示以及，語意不對。

why: as soon as 表示一……就……，要求盡快確認。
say: Please confirm the order number as soon as you receive this email.

prompt: We would appreciate your prompt reply. prompt 的意思是？
text: We would appreciate your prompt reply.
options: 迅速的
詳細的
禮貌的

wrong.詳細的: detailed 才是詳細，prompt 指不拖延。
wrong.禮貌的: polite 才是禮貌，prompt 表示及時。

why: prompt reply 是立刻或及時的回覆。
say: We would appreciate your prompt reply.

prompt: 你想在郵件結尾禮貌地表示期待對方回覆。
options: I look forward to hearing from you.
I look forward to hear from you.
I am looking forward hear you.
answer: I look forward to hearing from you.

look forward to 的 to 是介系詞，後面要接 V-ing。
缺少介系詞 to，也要接 V-ing，hear you 的意思不同。

why: look forward to + V-ing 表示期待。
say: I look forward to hearing from you.

prompt: 哪一句才是正確的英文？
options: The invoice is attached for your reference.
The invoice attach for your reference.
The invoice has attached for your reference.
answer: The invoice is attached for your reference.

缺少 be 動詞，被附上要用被動。
wrong.The invoice has attached for your refere: has attached 變成主動，invoice 不會自己附上。

why: is attached 為被動，表示發票被附在信中。
say: The invoice is attached for your reference.

text: Due to a machine problem, the delivery will be _____ by two days.
options: delayed
delaying
delay

wrong.delaying: will be 後面要接過去分詞表示被動，不能是 delaying。
wrong.delay: will be delay 不通順，被動要用過去分詞。

why: will be + 過去分詞 表示未來被動，被延遲。
say: The delivery will be delayed by two days.

prompt: Could you expedite the order? expedite 的意思是？
options: 加快處理訂單
取消訂單
重新列印訂單

wrong.取消訂單: 取消是 cancel，expedite 是使加快。
wrong.重新列印訂單: 句中沒有重新列印的意思。

why: expedite = 使加速處理，常用在訂單、出貨。

prompt: 客戶抱怨你們錯寄了貨，你要簡短道歉並說明會更換。
options: Sorry for the mistake. We will replace the item at no cost.
Sorry of the mistake. We replace the item for no cost.
Sorry for the mistake. We will replacing the item at no cost.
answer: Sorry for the mistake. We will replace the item at no cost.

wrong.Sorry of the mistake. We replace the ite: 道歉用 sorry for，at no cost 才是固定說法。
wrong.Sorry for the mistake. We will replacing: will 後面要接原形動詞 replace。

why: sorry for 道歉，will replace 承諾更換，at no cost 表示免費。
say: Sorry for the mistake. We will replace the item at no cost.
